schema: Each candidate ends in exactly one disposition state from {NEW_OWNER_HERE, CROSS_REFERENCE_ACTIVE_PACK, ALREADY_IMPLEMENTED, REFUTED_OR_UNREACHABLE, DEFERRED_TO_NAMED_STAGE_OR_OWNER, EVIDENCE_BLOCKED, HISTORICAL_ONLY}. No accepted requirement or unit may have two active owners. candidate_id is the overlap-reconciliation namespace (OPS-*-NNN, sequenced by candidate) and is intentionally distinct from the findings-register IDs in artifacts/findings.json (OPS-*-NNN, sequenced by accepted finding); the two namespaces must not be assumed to match 1:1.

reconciliation_authorities.outcome: Whole-repo engineering quality consolidation (85 sources, 67 units)
owned_for_this_audit: Performance, queues/cron engineering topology, upload state machine, observability repository, auth-read coalescing, CI truthful-claims unit (UNIT-002)
Every SEC-* remediation (realtime revocation, worker-edge seam, queue signing, email CRLF/HTML chokepoint, retention registry, etc.)

candidates.title: Worker deployment identity, version, and source SHA provenance cannot be verified without wrangler auth
candidates.justification: Hosted deployment provenance is not owned by any active pack. Quality Master UNIT-002 owns *truthful claims* about CI; Infosec UNIT-012 owns *activation* of CI. Neither owns the operator-facing deployment provenance receipt.

candidates.title: workers.dev secondary origin reachable; canonical-host redirect is partial mitigation
candidates.justification: Owned by Infosec SEC-WORKER-002 / UNIT-002. This audit contributes the hosted reachability evidence; the remediation is owned there.

candidates.title: Public marketing page cache-control s-maxage=31536000
candidates.justification: Owned by Infosec SEC-BROWSER-002 / UNIT-013. Hosted header evidence contributed here.

candidates.title: Hosted D1 migration parity and schema fingerprint unverified
candidates.justification: Not owned by any active pack. MVP-Startup UNIT-004 owns backup/PITR enablement only, not migration drift detection.

candidates.title: Hosted D1 recovery (backup window, restore duration, permissions) unverified
candidates.justification: MVP-Startup UNIT-004 owns PITR *enablement* and a *preview* restore drill but explicitly defers hosted D1 recovery proof. The hosted-evidence gap is unique to this audit.

candidates.title: scripts/generate-cloudflare-d1-restore-rehearsal.ts is localOnly:true / providerBacked:false
candidates.justification: Source explicitly emits these fields. This is correct behavior, not a defect; we cite it to prevent the local-only rehearsal from being misread as hosted recovery proof.

candidates.title: Hosted R2 object inventory, orphan-cleanup state, and retention evidence unverified
candidates.justification: Quality Master owns the upload/scanner *topology*; Infosec owns the upload *security invariants*. Hosted R2 object lifecycle and orphan-cleanup operational state are not owned.

candidates.title: Live queue DLQ depth, poison message posture, and operator inspection unverified
candidates.justification: Quality Master owns queue *contract/topology* (UNIT-019/024); Infosec owns queue message *signing* (UNIT-008). Live DLQ depth and operator-inspection runbook are unique to this audit.

candidates.title: Missed-cron-run detection and cron-failure alert not wired at the hosted layer
candidates.justification: Quality Master UNIT-028 owns the empty-cron-event-write fix (resolved). Infosec UNIT-010 owns cron-path redaction. Operator-visible cron-failure alerting (a hosted Cloudflare Alert or app-level periodic probe) is unique to this audit.

candidates.title: Hosted DO storage use, alarm posture, and SQLite-backed revocation state unverified
candidates.justification: Infosec UNIT-001 owns the *revocation logic* (DO SQLite denylist); Quality Master UNIT-033 owns *backpressure*. Hosted DO storage capacity, alarm behavior, and version-compat across deploys are unique to this audit.

candidates.title: Hosted Google OAuth callback round-trip not exercised end-to-end
candidates.justification: Infosec owns token/session security; Quality Master owns session-read coalescing. The hosted OAuth round-trip (login→callback→session cookie→/workshop) is unique to this audit and requires operator action.

candidates.title: Inbound MX routes @archestimator.com via Namecheap eforward, not Cloudflare Email Routing
candidates.justification: Infosec UNIT-004 owns outbound email CRLF/HTML chokepoint. The inbound mail-routing topology and reply-path inconsistency (outbound FROM via Cloudflare Email, replies land in Namecheap) are unique to this audit.

candidates.title: DMARC p=none and no DKIM published; SPF authorizes Namecheap only
candidates.justification: Email DNS posture is operational/deliverability, not Infosec's CRLF/HTML scope. Unique to this audit.

candidates.title: Hosted alert delivery for S-01..S-07 scenarios unverified
candidates.justification: Application-level alert scaffolding (operational-alerts.ts) is repo-local; the *delivery* of those alerts to an operator-visible sink (webhook reachable, alerts actually fire on trigger conditions) requires hosted proof.

candidates.title: Hosted Workers Logs retention duration and TTL not evidenced
candidates.justification: wrangler.jsonc has no explicit retention; defaults apply. Operator must verify and pin the retention so incident reconstruction is possible during the controlled beta.

candidates.title: Controlled-beta release gate must be exercised end-to-end (GO/CONDITIONAL_GO/NO_GO) before each cohort wave
candidates.justification: MVP-Startup pack owns the readiness audit; Quality Master owns CI truthfulness. The operator-facing release-gate ritual (smoke fixture, release receipt, fix-forward playbook) is unique to this audit.

candidates.title: Operator runbook for 11 failure scenarios (bad deploy, bad migration, D1 corruption, R2 divergence, queue poison, cron runaway, DO state issue, OAuth outage, email outage, domain/TLS issue, alerting outage)
candidates.justification: Recovery playbook is operator-facing and unique to this audit. Existing packs own root-cause remediation, not operator response.

candidates.title: Empty-cron-event-write concern resolved
candidates.justification: Quality Master UNIT-028 owns this. Confirmed in current source: every cron branch writes exactly one recordCronRunEvent.

candidates.title: 30 3 * * * cron also records upload-jobs:unmatched-cron row (cosmetic noise)
candidates.justification: Cosmetic noise in cron_run_events for the 30 3 path (records both upload-jobs:unmatched-cron and retention-pass). Deferred to Quality Master as an engineering nit, not operator-facing.

candidates.title: CI/CD workflows disabled
candidates.justification: Owned by Infosec UNIT-012 (AUXILIARY, AUTH-001 gated) and Quality Master UNIT-002 (truthful-claims). This audit notes the hosted consequence (no automated release gate) but does not duplicate the remediation.

candidates.title: Five-minute drain runs 3 jobs (notifications + 2 template reconciliations) in parallel waitUntil
candidates.justification: Source-confirmed at worker.ts:205-237. Parallel Promise.all is the correct design; each writes one cron-run-event with a merged summary.
